set -euo pipefail

calendar="/workspace/calendar.txt"

usage() {
  cat <<USAGE
Usage:
  $0 'Title' 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'   Add an event
  $0 list                         List events
  $0 export-ics [OUTPUT.ics]      Export events to ICS
USAGE
}

ics_escape() {
  local s="$1"
  s="${s//\\/\\\\}"
  s="${s//,/\\,}"
  s="${s//;/\\;}"
  s="${s//$'\r'/}"
  echo "$s"
}

to_dtstart() {
  local dt="$1"
  local s="${dt//-/}"
  s="${s//:/}"
  s="${s// /T}"
  echo "${s}00"
}

generate_uid() {
  local line="$1"
  if command -v sha1sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "$(printf "%s" "$line" | sha1sum | awk '{print $1}')@local"
  else
    echo "$RANDOM-$(date +%s%N)@local"
  fi
}

now_utc() {
  date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ
}

add_event() {
  local title="$1" dt="$2"
  printf "%s,%s\n" "$dt" "$title" >> "$calendar"
  echo "Event added: $title at $dt"
}

list_events() {
  if [[ -f "$calendar" ]]; then
    sort "$calendar" | awk -F, '{printf "%-16s %s\n",$1,$2}'
  else
    echo "No events found."
  fi
}

export_ics() {
  local out="${1:-/workspace/calendar.ics}"
  if [[ ! -f "$calendar" ]]; then
    echo "No events to export."
    return 1
  fi
  {
    echo "BEGIN:VCALENDAR"
    echo "VERSION:2.0"
    echo "PRODID:-//OpenHands//Calendar//EN"
    echo "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN"
    echo "METHOD:PUBLISH"
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
      dt="${line%%,*}"
      title="${line#*,}"
      dtstart="$(to_dtstart "$dt")"
      summary="$(ics_escape "$title")"
      uid="$(generate_uid "$line")"
      stamp="$(now_utc)"
      echo "BEGIN:VEVENT"
      echo "UID:$uid"
      echo "DTSTAMP:$stamp"
      echo "DTSTART:$dtstart"
      echo "SUMMARY:$summary"
      echo "END:VEVENT"
    done < <(sort "$calendar")
    echo "END:VCALENDAR"
  } > "$out"
  echo "Exported ICS to $out"
}

main() {
  if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
    usage
    exit 1
  fi
  case "$1" in
    list)
      list_events
      ;;

ics_escape() {
  local s="$1"

}

  local dt="$1"

  s="${s//:/}"
  s="${s// /T}"

}

generate_uid() {
  local line="$1"
  if command -v sha1sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "$(printf "%s" "$line" | sha1sum | awk '{print $1}')@local"
  else
    echo "$RANDOM-$(date +%s%N)@local"
  fi
}

now_utc() {
  date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ
}

add_event() {
  local title="$1" dt="$2"
  printf "%s,%s\n" "$dt" "$title" >> "$calendar"

    echo "VERSION:2.0"
    echo "PRODID:-//OpenHands//Calendar//EN"
    echo "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN"
    echo "METHOD:PUBLISH"

      summary="$(ics_escape "$title")"
      uid="$(generate_uid "$line")"
      stamp="$(now_utc)"
      echo "BEGIN:VEVENT"
      echo "UID:$uid"
      echo "DTSTAMP:$stamp"
      echo "DTSTART:$dtstart"
      echo "SUMMARY:$summary"
      echo "END:VEVENT"
    done < <(sort "$calendar")
    echo "END:VCALENDAR"
  } > "$out"
  echo "Exported ICS to $out"
}

main() {
  if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
    usage
    exit 1

  case "$1" in
    list)

      export_ics "${1:-}"

      usage

    *)
      if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then
        usage
        exit 1
      fi
      local title="$1" dt="$2"
      add_event "$title" "$dt"
      ;;
  esac
}

main "$@"
